    Profile

    Nefertiti is a noble within the desert lands and the older sister of Ramses. She is very clever and wise, but keeps her secrets close to home and can deceive with a mere smile. Beautiful yet unforgiving, she strikes fear into her enemies' hearts, which has earned her the title of Desert Lily.

    Origin: Desert Zone
    Gender: Female
    Height: 168cm
    Weight: 45kg
    Birthday: Aug 27
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Swift Sails
    Likes: Chocolate
    Hobbies: Reading, geology
    Illust: 大盛よしを
    CV: 山崎日向穂
